explication: umu is a Linux launcher for Windows games: a user supplies a game executable, launch arguments, and optional prefix, storefront, game ID, and Proton version; umu prepares the environment and launches Proton with the game in the Steam runtime container. The README also describes shared game fixes, while the sampled files do not show their implementation. Edges involving unsampled modules rely on SOURCE INDEX references; documented behavior is attributed to the README.
